# Tennis Analytics

> Surface-aware Elo ratings and betting-market analysis for ATP men's tennis,
> computed deterministically from public raw data. Not betting advice.

## What this site provides
- ATP Elo rankings (overall + clay/hard/grass), 195 ranked players.
- Player pages: career/seasonal stats, surface splits, form, pressure (break
  points, tiebreaks, deciding sets), and market mispricing metrics.
- Match pages: Elo win probability vs betting-market implied odds (5976 recent).

## Data lineage
- Matches/rankings: Jeff Sackmann tennis_atp (public).
- Closing odds: tennis-data.co.uk (Pinnacle, Bet365, market max).
- Methodology + formulas: https://leugimoguh.github.io/about/

## Key pages
- Rankings: https://leugimoguh.github.io/
- Clay: https://leugimoguh.github.io/rankings/clay/
- Sitemap: https://leugimoguh.github.io/sitemap.xml
